composition_variation: Illustrate Tanjiro Kamado sitting peacefully on a wooden veranda, folding a small green paper crane. He wears his recognizable checkered haori over a fully closed casual outfit. Place a few red maple leaves near his knees and an empty ceramic plate beside him. Use warm autumn watercolor, gentle pencil outlines, softly glowing skin, and layered garden depth. Keep his hands simple and natural. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
